area: Temple Mills / Leyton marsh: Temple Mill Lane running between two ditches (C.D., U.D. and county/parliamentary borough boundaries), a sluice and bridge in the NE, open marsh south of the lane, embanked path/railway line and buildings in the SE
method: All 9 sweep crops (2x) viewed; all candidates confirmed on 8x contact sheets (+-30 px); ambiguous digits re-read at 16x and 24x and compared with clear 5s (15·1, 15·4 at 530,366) and a clear 6 (14·6) on the same mosaic. All crops and zooms loaded and were viewed successfully.
legibility: Clean coloured sheet (blue water) north of the join; the lane figures are small and the 5/6 distinction is hard. Horizontal sheet join at py ~538-540 across the full width: uncoloured, darker-tinted sheet below (sheet tool: ~535). Lower half almost blank marsh.
